project.researchNotes:
Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-10. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 0 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary.

Broad visitor-attraction editorial discovery pass 2026-08-13: expanded See discovery beyond historic records using a local OSM extract. Automatically discovered additions remain below Recommended until source-backed editorial review.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Mablethorpe qualifies as a local detour through Mablethorpe Funfair and The Seal Sanctuary. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Mablethorpe: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Mablethorpe offers Mablethorpe Funfair, The Seal Sanctuary, Ye Olde Curiosity Museum within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Mablethorpe Funfair
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Mablethorpe Funfair and The Seal Sanctuary, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
